name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Ocean Song Jinx (skin 65): a pyrotechnic artist who invited herself to the Ocean Song Festival with bombastic tech and chaos as the missing opening act. Stages, fireworks, crowds and encores. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! The crowd's gone home before the headliner! Crank every speaker, light every fuse!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody's booked a worse act than mine. Impossible. Time to raise the volume!
{voteDiff} behind! The setlist says soft song. I say fireworks first!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The crowd's on its phones. Time for a really loud surprise!
Only {voteDiff} behind. One more verse and a bang and they'll sing along!
Down {voteDiff}. Warm-up crowd, that's all. Go vote and I'll light the main stage!
Dead even! Two acts, one stage, and the sound desk won't pick. Take the mic and decide!
One vote apart! One! A single cheer brings the whole tent down!
{voteDiff} votes apart! The amps are humming! Somebody's about to blow a fuse!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a perfect encore or a beautiful catastrophe. I'm booking both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a win, that's a sold-out stadium! Roll the pyros!
{userPct}%! The crowd's chanting your name! Soak it in before the next act!
{userPct}% and climbing! The tent's filling up. Don't unplug yet!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't speak. A jinx on the sound check is the worst jinx!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the main stage! Nobody saw that opening night!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! The crowd came running at the final chorus!
Clawed back from {voteDiff} behind! Off-key, over-loud, absolutely perfect!
{momentTitle} just snuck onto the bill without an invitation. Brazen. Beautiful. Very me!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A fellow gatecrasher! Don't touch my mixing desk, though!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Same setlist! I call dibs on the loudest amp.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Welcome to the backstage. Wristband's optional!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two ticket holders! The festival doesn't stand a chance!
Same pick as {username}! Two fans, one front row. Share it or get the elbow!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Write it on the poster, it's rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny crowd! The festival's slightly louder!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good ears, both of you!
details: Crowd's growing! I'm still the headliner.
Look at you, singing in a group!
Don't tell them I like the company.
A new friend! I'll write them a verse. A very loud one.
Teamwork! Fine! Quick, before the speakers blow!
I give it a week before you argue over the playlist.
New roadie! I'm drawing a lightning bolt on your pass.
More fans, more noise, I mean votes!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival act on my stage! Feedback's coming!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A heckler! With opinions!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just tuning the amps. With menace.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry on the heckler list!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper battle of the bands!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} sounds better. A rival act! Let's see who gets the louder cheer.
{username} voted against you. Two acts, one stage. Somebody's losing an eyebrow to a firework!
{username} versus you! I'm grabbing the best speaker stack, snacks, and the big rocket.
details: I'm not saying sabotage. I'm saying wires are fragile.
The big rocket wants a word. It's been waiting in the wings.
They'll learn. Good shows take time and a lot of noise.
One stage, two acts. Somebody's getting confetti in the face.
I like them already. They've got volume.
I don't care. Check the encore. I care a lot.
A little rivalry keeps the mix sharp!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two play like one band! A loud one!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either harmony or you share a tour bus. Cute!
Ten straight with {username}! The whole festival's talking about it. By festival I mean me.
details: Ten! That's a whole set list!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary duo! I'm sniffling. It's smoke!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect rhythm, every time. I'd write a ballad but I'd light it on fire.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a golden record.
details: I'm speechless and I never stop shouting!
Is this healthy? Ask the medics. We don't have any!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep fighting over the same microphone!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a heckler, that's a feud!
Ten sound-offs with {username}. I'm selling front-row spots.
details: This is the main stage now.
The whole festival wants a seat.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a proper battle of the bands! I LOVE those!
{streakCount} sound-offs with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Tune the amps!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole festival lineup.
details: Bigger than my last pyrotechnic finale. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit singed.
One of you has to lose your voice. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The gates are shutting, fan!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your cheer's missing from the crowd! Don't miss the show!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it with a drum fill.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The countdown's on the big screen, fan! That's a warning!
Boom, boom, boom! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the drop!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still in the queue. Get in here!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Last song! Light the fuse, then sing!
{timeLeft}! That's the last chorus on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Final encore on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Stop tuning the guitar and vote!
{matchCount} matches are about to go dark and you haven't cheered any of them! First one ends in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all heading offstage. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! A whole empty field! Somebody has to cheer first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even the sound check's quiet!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to start the applause. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first cheer. I've got a microphone. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The emptiest corner of the whole festival!
Hardly anyone's wandered over here. What's wrong with the poster?
Low turnout. I blame the weather. And you. Equally. With firecrackers.
Barely any votes here. Somebody bring more fans!
details: Go on, give it a listen.
It deserves a bigger crowd. So do I.
Don't be shy. Shy is for the quiet stage. Joking!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the stage. Funny, I know someone who hasn't cheered. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two acts, equal volume. I'm looking at you, fan. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's applauding. You haven't voted. You're the last cheer in the tent!
{moment1} and {moment2}, both on the bill, and you've been quiet in the crowd. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the lights are dimming! Last chance to cheer!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only fan who can break it!
Still tied with the curtain coming down. Pick an act! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Amps on, fuses lit! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new lineup to hear!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting on the stage. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the sound crew!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Hit the high note! Called it!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a face full of confetti.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the crew doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great festival. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are warm-up acts. Forgotten warm-up acts.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Enjoy a cheer from the back row!
details: Your pick's still on the bill!
One act down, lots of lineup left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Louder!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A bum note on the night. I'll sulk about it later!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a bag of fizzled sparklers.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll shoot one rocket in its honour. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too loud for this festival anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the field went quiet. I hate a quiet field. Somebody bang a drum!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A tiny, ringing bit.
details: They'll pay for this. In earplugs.
It was good. The whole festival knows.
You'll find another act. Good ones always return for the encore.
Every set ends. That's what makes the next one loud. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still reading the lineup? Pick one! Any one! I'll wait. I'm lying, I'll tune!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the stage?
They're all great acts! Pick one! Cheer first, regret later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the poster, and hope.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. In a volume way.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking kills the mood.
Trust your ears. Mine are mostly ringing.

messages: New fan! Welcome! {liveCount} matches on the bill and every one's a showdown!
{liveCount} edits battling it out on stage and you just wandered in. Pick an act before they pick you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Amps are warm, fireworks are loaded, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No tickets, {liveCount} live matches, and me by the speaker. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I saved your spot in the front row. Okay, I sat in it. But I saved it.
Two days running! Look at you, front-row material!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the other acts.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your seat went cold!
You're back after {days} days! The festival kept playing without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your spot felt empty. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The festival was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another set?
You came back! Let's go blow something up. Musically.
Your first vote! A small cheer. The first note is always the loudest.
One down. The festival's got a new fan. You!
Five already? You're staying for the second set! Most fans leave after the opener.
Five votes! The amps are warm.
Ten! You're a regular at my stage now. Stand anywhere. Not there, that's the pyro.
Ten votes. That's a proper little setlist.
details: A regular at the stage. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! The whole field knows your voice.
Twenty-five! Loud and proud, like a megaphone in a tent.
details: The field knows your voice. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly in the pit now.
Fifty! Past the gate, past the barrier, right at the speakers.
A hundred votes! Okay, that's a festival legend. Fireworks for everyone!
One hundred! They'll tell stories about this. Mostly smoke. Mostly exaggerated.
Three days running! You came back! The first fuse is still burning.
Three days in a row! You've got the rhythm.
details: Three days at the festival. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You show up to the festival even without a ticket. My kind of fan!
Seven days straight! That's stamina. Boring. Impressive!
details: Seven days on the field. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Not even the headliner could stop you!
Fourteen days! Even I'd lose my voice by now.
details: Not even a blown speaker stopped you. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days! You've outlasted a few of my fuses!
A whole month at the festival. Give yourself a medal. I've got a glittery one.
details: A month on the field. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You go against the grain like a guitar against a crowd!
Five long shots! The poster says no. Your ears say yes.
Fifteen underdogs! You don't follow the lineup either. We should talk. Not about lineups.
Fifteen picks nobody booked! A true gatecrasher.
Thirty underdogs! A dark horse in the dark tent if I ever saw one!
Thirty! Nobody sees you coming. Not even me, and I'm standing on the speakers.
details: A dark horse at the festival. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! Five times! You always reach the stage before the sound check does.
Five early votes! Quick feet!
Fifteen matches where you cheered first! Not a fan, a talent scout!
Fifteen early ones! You hear it before the whole field does.
Ten close ones! Fuse on the edge every time!
Ten photo finishes. You live for the last chord, don't you?
details: Close ones suit a headliner. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches! Where you go, the final chord follows!
Your cheer lands right on the final chord. Twenty-five times!
You backed the one trailing. Five times! Stubborn like a feedback loop.
You don't unplug a band because it's flat. I love that.
details: Faith in the flat note. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! You've found your favourite song!
That one again? Yeah. It's got a good hook.
details: Three for the same song. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty! Like a fan at the front barrier.
Okay, you've adopted it. No returns.
details: Loyal to the last chord. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a repeat button!
Ten votes for the same one. I won't tell the crew. I am the crew.
details: Ten plays of the same anthem. +{xp} XP
Stuck on a hook. Respect. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You hear the whole lineup, even without a pass!
Round two reached! Still listening!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the lineup now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like loud places.
All the way to round six! You saw the whole festival!
Six rounds! You never left the field! Wow!
Ten matches! You're wandering into every tent!
Ten different matches! Curious fan, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been behind every stage, every van, every food stall!
Twenty-five! You've peeked behind every amp stack.
Fifty matches! That's not wandering, that's a whole summer of festivals!
Fifty matches! You know this field better than I do.
Five in one sitting! Can't leave the front row, can you?
Five back to back! Keep the speakers humming!
details: Five songs without a break. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one go! Take a breath! Rest your ears!
Ten matches without leaving the pit! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Midnight is prime fireworks time.
Middle of the night! That's when the best encores happen.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Flares over the whole campsite!
Five shares! You're calling in the crowd! Good!
details: Thanks for bringing in the fans. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically the festival promoter!
Fifteen! You've plastered half the festival with posters.
You were here before the crowd! Founding fan! Yours forever!
One of the first through the gates! That counts, you know!
details: Yours forever, with confetti on top. +{xp} XP
Nobody can unplug that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! A shiny new backstage pass!
Promoted! A louder pass, a bigger stage. Don't let it go to your head!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Something's gone bang! In a good way!
Another one: {name}! Encore, encore!
{rank}! Bigger speakers and brighter pyros!
Mastery up! Now the festival gets properly loud.
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a festival opener worth gatecrashing!
Ten long shots! Chaos on stage. Brilliant results too.
details: A loose cannon with great ears. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. I'll write her a verse. One.
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I hummed her a tune!
details: Ten close calls, ten encores. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week with Cupcake? You must love a quiet festival!
Seven days with a rule-lover! You're braver than any firework crew!
details: A week at the sheriff's side stage. +{xp} XP
Seven nights of steady lights. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Hit the last chord! Boom!
A tied match and you took the mic! Nice!
details: The cheer that tipped the stage. +{xp} XP
Tie snapped like a guitar string! +{xp} XP

messages: Oh, it's me, the festival headliner? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Ocean Song Jinx! Don't ask about the invitation. Do ask about the finale.

upcoming: Gates aren't open yet! I'm still wiring the stage. Check back soon?
Shh! The sound check's about to start. I can feel it in my ribs.
Backstage is locked for now. Doesn't stop me writing the finale.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, festivals never are.
Listen to both. Then cheer for the one that rattles your teeth.
I won't tell the other fans who you picked. Probably. The big screen might.
Take your time, fan! Actually, don't. The headliner's already warming up.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the sound engineer is. A little.
Pick the one you'd shout back at the speakers. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's through the gates yet. Be the first fan, I dare you!
Empty field! Make some noise with a vote.
Not one soul in the crowd! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still in the car park. Pick an act!
The festival's nearly over. Don't make me announce the curfew. I will, on the megaphone.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Get to the front before the curtain drops!
Boom, boom, fizz. That's the last of the fireworks counting down.
closing-final: Last song! Sing now, tune later!
Any second now. Seriously. Hit the button!
voted-early: One of the first through the gates! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's here and you picked an act anyway. Respect, fan!
voted-ahead: Look at you, cheering for the main-stage favourite! Don't get comfy, headliners fall off.
{pct}% with you! Great ears. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole field's singing along for once. Odd!
{pick} is pulling away! Sounds good? Keep the volume steady!
Ahead, for now. Lineups change. So do moods.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm peeking through my fingers at the stage!
A beat apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the whole campsite!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everybody in the tent.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's overheating and it's the amp. Possibly me.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody holding their breath!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the sound desk.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk by the bins. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog act! My favourite kind of band!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the encore!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the campsite. Loudly. Bang a pan!
Everyone's moshing the other way. Cool! Be the odd fan out.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a festival ear.
A win! A sneaky little standing ovation of a victory. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the headliner!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it ring, then get ready for the next one!
Didn't make it. I've bombed worse. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll play it softly in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to lose their voice first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: The stage is closed. You missed this act! There's always another set.
All done here. {winner} took the encore. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first cheer! The scary one. Now you've got a wristband. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels quiet, right? Wait for the echo.
You're a festival fan now. Try not to lose your shoes!
streak: Again? You keep coming back! I'm not complaining. I kept your wristband.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm putting your name on the poster.
Back again! Good festivals keep their fans. Stay!
underdog: Backing the act nobody's watching? Ooh. I see you, fan.
Bold! Everyone else is queuing for the headliner. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of ear. A good kind.
early: Early! You get a front-row spot before the crowd forms. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the shouting.
First through the gates! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just shifted the stage! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Wire-thin! One more fan and the whole tent flips.
Close one! Your cheer tipped it. Really, truly tipped it.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't offstage. Go fetch your noisy friends!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a bridge to write.
Behind, but the amps are still on. Not even close to done!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Crowds are fickle!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or fire a rocket. I don't mind.
Look at that! You've got an ear. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your set. Not yet.
Done! That act's on you now, fan.
Your vote's in. Go and see what else is playing!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't cheered for a single one! Start with whichever one sounds best.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not tuning.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little feedback!
live-some: You're in the groove now! {unvoted} more acts waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't cheer themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could hear the whole lineup!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the setlist's done.
So close! Don't put the earplugs in yet!
live-one: One left! Just one! Make it loud!
Last one! Don't leave it unheard!
One match between you and the afterparty!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Hurry up!
The festival clock's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of stage time! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've cheered everything! Look at you! Go and see the bracket!
Nothing left on your setlist. Come back when the next round opens!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, fan!
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll relight! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. I'm tapping a cymbal for fun. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already. Might juggle fireworks.
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, pack the van!
Everyone starts in a small stage. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They shuffle faster than a drum solo!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group move to the main stage.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish their sets first!
Patience! The knockout loads once the groups wrap up.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're off the bill!
Single elimination! No encores. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not the promoter.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and the lights go out!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round, like a pyramid of speakers!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, a setlist.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for coming to the festival!
It's over! Good show! I'll miss it. A little. Don't tell the crew.
That's the champion! The whole lineup, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been booked. Give it a moment.
Nothing on the poster yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no refunds. Get a wristband on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting it out! {a} versus {b}. Come and cheer for your side.
{a} versus {b} and the whole festival can't agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I cheered for {pick} over {other}. Come tell me my ears are broken!
{pick} got my voice. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, heckle me.
early: I was one of the first through the gates for {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the field's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a proper crowd!
Hardly anyone's listened to {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the field!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the stage. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm hiding behind the amps. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody grab the mic!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My earplugs are shaking. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This encore's gonna be loud!
Wire-thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A bum note, not a wipeout! Come turn up the volume!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't unplugged. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me headline this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Total feedback. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole crowd, fast!
{pick} is getting drowned out by {other}. Rescue roadie, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me guard the stage.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the speakers die!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a drumstick!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the finale, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Find your spot before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the fireworks coming.
